div.div:
Other answers of the backend (the run is not stored)
Before message 3: 401 no valid API key · 403 the use case of the key is not registered · 413 body over 10 MiB · 400 body not valid · 403 the body names another use case than the key.
After message 3, when a row exists: 200 duplicate (the same content; the stored row is returned) · 409 conflict (different content; nothing changes).
One trace The job's spans (batch.run and its children) and the backend's spans have the same trace ID, from the traceparent header. The Collector also writes every span to a rotated span file.
